title: Student Technology Device Program Training Note: Charging Damage and Accessories
content:
This training note sets out how the Student Technology Device Program charges a damage incident and a lost or damaged charger or case.

## The rule

1. Each damage incident is charged by the repair it needs: the loan type's screen repair, keyboard or touchpad repair, liquid damage repair or charging port or hinge repair charge.
2. Under the Technology Protection Plan, the first accidental incident of the school year is charged the loan type's first-incident charge, the second the second-incident charge, and the third and later the full repair cost, never more than the repair cost; without the plan every incident is charged the full repair cost.
3. Damage the campus finds intentional is charged the full repair cost with or without the plan.
4. A charge of 0.00 posts no charge; the incident record is the record.
5. Chargers and cases are never covered by the plan and are charged the loan type's charger replacement cost or case replacement cost.
6. When incidents in a school year reach 3, the campus administrator reviews take-home use; the review does not change charges.

## Which incident of the school year it is

An incident's place in the school year is the count of damage incidents (screen, keyboard, liquid or port) recorded on the student's device loans of that school year, the new incident included. The school year runs July 1 to June 30. Loss, theft, charger and case incidents are not counted.

## Decision table

| Loan carries the plan | Campus finds the damage intentional | Incident's place in the school year | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | First | The first-incident charge, or the repair cost if that is lower |
| Yes | No | Second | The second-incident charge, or the repair cost if that is lower |
| Yes | No | Third or later | The full repair cost |
| Yes | Yes | Any | The full repair cost |
| No | Either | Any | The full repair cost |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, not schedule figures)

Suppose a plan loan with a hypothetical first-incident charge of 10.00, a second-incident charge of 60.00 and a repair cost of 45.00 for the repair needed.

- First accidental incident of the school year: 10.00.
- Second: the second-incident charge of 60.00 is more than the repair cost, so the charge is 45.00.
- Third: the full repair cost, 45.00.
- Had the first-incident charge been 0.00, no charge would post for the first incident, and the incident record would stand as the record.

A hypothetical lost charger on a plan loan is charged the loan type's charger replacement cost in full, the plan notwithstanding.

## Points of judgement

- The count runs across all of the student's device loans of the school year, not loan by loan.
- The take-home review at 3 incidents leaves every charge as the rule above sets it.
